items.title: Commonplace book
items.text: Notebooks that compile quotes, proverbs, poems, tables, etc.

items.title: Deliberate practice
items.text: Deliberate practice focuses on the hardest, most difficult parts. I find this essential when building skills.

items.title: Learning in public
items.text: Learning in public is the practice of sharing what you learn, as you learn it.

items.title: On the shoulders of giants
items.quote: If I have seen further [than others], it is by standing on the shoulders of giants.

items.title: Spaced repetition
items.text: A memorization technique with flashcards in which you new and more difficult items are presented more frequently than older and easier ones.
